hiring_bar_summary.text: Stated eligibility is broad (all fields, undergraduates and non-MBA master's students), and the screen is then explicit and staged: a timed Consulting Career Assessment for US applicants, an online case for selected candidates, and case interviews. No GPA cutoff is published on the official US page checked.

facts.claim: Official page: US applicants complete the Consulting Career Assessment, sent 30-90 minutes after applying, taking about 30-35 minutes, with 48 hours to complete it; selected candidates are invited to an online case of about 35 minutes roughly two weeks after the application deadline.

screening_signals.claim: Consulting Career Assessment (CCA) for US applicants: described by BCG as giving multidimensional insight into potential for success beyond the resume, to be completed within 48 hours of the invitation.
Online case (about 35 minutes) for a select group of candidates, invited about two weeks after the application deadline.
Application requires confirming your top two office preferences, and a cover letter is not required for Summer or Full-Time applications.

process_stages.stage: Online application by the dated deadline, with top-two office preferences
process_stages.description: Separate US and international applications depending on office preferences.
Invitation arrives 30-90 minutes after submission; about 30-35 minutes; 48-hour completion window.
About 35 minutes; invitations about two weeks after the application deadline; candidates who previously took it are not prompted again.
Case study interviews simulating a real client problem, per BCG's official preparation page; round counts and timing are set by office and are not stated on the US page checked.

interview_styles.style: Candidate-led case study interview: structure the problem, ask questions, analyse data, calculate, and reason to a recommendation where there is not always a single right answer
interview_styles.note: Per BCG's official case-preparation page. Community advice on a specific number of practice cases is folklore and is not quantified in this record.

values_culture_signals.claim: BCG's official case-preparation page presents mutual respect and mindfulness, trust, collaboration and leadership through continuous learning as cultural markers - the firm's own framing.

hiring_cadence.text: One dated summer window per role in the 2026 cycle (early June for Summer Associate, early July for full-time), materially earlier than a traditional fall cycle, with assessment steps following within weeks of the deadline.

facts.claim: June 2, 2026 and July 7, 2026 deadlines per Columbia career center.
Official page confirms both 2027 windows have closed as of the October 2026 check.

compensation_notes.text: No Associate compensation figure is published on the official US Associate page checked; none is claimed. Third-party salary figures are not treated as facts in this record.

referral_weight_notes.text: No reliable public source quantifying referral weight was found. BCG's published process routes every US applicant through the same CCA after applying, which is the only screening structure this record can evidence.

red_flags: As of 2026-10-12 both US windows for 2027 opportunities are closed - there is no live US Associate window to apply to at this record's date; the next cycle's dates must be re-verified.
The deadlines in this cycle were in June and July, not fall - a student waiting for a fall recruiting season would have missed BCG entirely.
The CCA's 48-hour completion window starts shortly after applying, so applying before you are ready to be assessed is a real cost.
thesis_text:
1. Bottom line: BCG is the earliest and most mechanical of the MBB undergraduate funnels in this cycle: one dated summer deadline, an assessment that lands in your inbox within hours of applying, and an online case for those who clear it. Eligibility is officially wide - every field, undergraduates and non-MBA master's students - so the differentiator is calendar discipline and case-plus-assessment readiness in June and July, not a published credential bar.
2. Who gets in (sourced, qualitative): Undergraduates and non-MBA master's students from all fields; full-time for graduation December 2026-August 2027 and Summer Associate for December 2027-August 2028 in this cycle; MBA students are routed to separate deadlines and are not eligible for these ones.
3. Stated vs revealed screen: Stated: all fields welcome, assessment designed to look beyond the resume, hiring decisions made by people. Revealed: unknown from public data - no sourced cohort distribution exists in this record.
4. Routes in, ranked: (1) Summer Associate in the June window if you are a rising senior; (2) full-time Associate in the July window if you are graduating; (3) BCG Launch and campus events in the year before, to be ready when the window opens; (4) if the window has closed, the same preparation applied to Bain, McKinsey and Deloitte windows.
5. Your gap: user-specific - compare school, experience, projects, skills and timing against the sourced signals in this record; no cohort percentages are claimed because no public population sample was available.
6. Plan: next 30 days - verify the live posting and deadline on the official page and build the role-specific skill evidence named in the posting; this semester - complete one internship, project or program that matches the entry route; this year - apply in the earliest window the firm offers for your graduation date.
7. Coffee-chat strategy: talk to recent entry-level hires and interns in the exact role family, and ask what the assessments and interviews actually tested and what surprised them.
8. Timeline and key dates: 2026 cycle (now closed): Summer Associate June 2, 2026; full-time July 7, 2026. CCA follows within 30-90 minutes of applying with a 48-hour completion window; online case about two weeks after the deadline for selected candidates. Next-cycle dates were not published on the official US page as of 2026-10-12.
9. Risks and alternatives: The main risk is timing, not eligibility: a missed June/July deadline costs a full year at this firm. Adjacent MBB and Big Four strategy roles run close but not identical calendars - track each firm's own page.
10. Offer to execute: I can build the target list, tailor the resume to this record, and draft outreach - say the word.
known_biases_of_data: Exact 2026 deadline dates come from a university career center notice; the official BCG page confirms the windows are closed but does not restate the dates.
Office-level interview round counts are not published on the US page checked, so none are asserted.
No population data - stated eligibility is not evidence about who is actually hired.
